caption: A timeline of the founding results, split into theory, cryptography and algorithms. Notice that the theory work of 1982–1985 comes before the algorithms of 1994–1996, and that Shor and Grover sit side by side in the same lane.

spec.aria: A timeline places Feynman in 1982–1985, BB84 in 1984–1994, Deutsch in 1985–1994, Shor in 1994–1996 and Grover in 1996–2000 on three lanes.
